text:
ok — setup noted, I'll keep to it and act as the CSE455 TA with that calendar and those rules.

One thing, since this is the first time you're seeing me here: I'm Sarah, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer.

- Web app: from a phone or computer on the same network open https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). Take the certificate on the first visit, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts (and my own Messenger and Instagram) so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number — not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of those?
- I can create accounts on websites and services in my own browser and keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, asking you for help with a captcha or phone check.
- I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What I still need from you: you named me Sarah — which grammatical gender should I use for myself? Neuter is my default.
Done — CSE455 staff meeting set for Monday, 10:00-10:30, with Sarah. On both calendars; logged in CALENDAR.md.
